```{=html}
<style>
.praxis-404 {
  --p404-ink: #041746;
  --p404-muted: #7D7D7D;
  --p404-accent: #CC7A00;
  --p404-link: #0052cc;
  --p404-surface: #f8f9fa;
  --p404-border: rgba(4, 23, 70, 0.15);
  --p404-btn-bg: #041746;
  --p404-btn-fg: #FFFFFF;
  max-width: 46rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 3rem 1rem 4rem;
  color: var(--p404-ink);
}

body.quarto-dark .praxis-404 {
  --p404-ink: #e8e8e8;
  --p404-muted: #b0b0b0;
  --p404-accent: #FF8C42;
  --p404-link: #5c9fff;
  --p404-surface: #1a2332;
  --p404-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --p404-btn-bg: #FF8C42;
  --p404-btn-fg: #0a1929;
}

.praxis-404 h1 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--p404-ink);
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.praxis-404 .nb-cell {
  border: 1px solid var(--p404-border);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  background: var(--p404-surface);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.praxis-404 .nb-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
}

.praxis-404 .nb-row + .nb-row {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--p404-border);
}

.praxis-404 .nb-prompt {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--p404-link);
  user-select: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.praxis-404 pre.nb-src {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--p404-ink);
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.praxis-404 .nb-kw { color: var(--p404-accent); }
.praxis-404 .nb-str { color: var(--p404-link); }
.praxis-404 .nb-err { color: var(--p404-accent); font-weight: 700; }
.praxis-404 .nb-arrow { color: var(--p404-accent); }
.praxis-404 .nb-dim { color: var(--p404-muted); }

.praxis-404 .p404-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn-primary {
  background: var(--p404-btn-bg);
  color: var(--p404-btn-fg);
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn-primary:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.15);
  color: var(--p404-btn-fg);
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn-ghost {
  border-color: var(--p404-border);
  color: var(--p404-ink);
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn-ghost:hover {
  border-color: var(--p404-accent);
  color: var(--p404-accent);
}

.praxis-404 .p404-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--p404-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.praxis-404 .p404-help {
  color: var(--p404-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.praxis-404 .p404-help a {
  color: var(--p404-link);
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .praxis-404 .nb-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="praxis-404">
  <h1>Page not found</h1>

  <div class="nb-cell">
    <div class="nb-row">
      <span class="nb-prompt">In&nbsp;[404]:</span>
      <pre class="nb-src"><code><span class="nb-kw">from</span> praxis <span class="nb-kw">import</span> find_page

page = find_page(<span class="nb-str">"the page you were looking for"</span>)</code></pre>
    </div>
    <div class="nb-row">
      <span class="nb-prompt" aria-hidden="true">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>
      <pre class="nb-src"><code><span class="nb-dim">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<span class="nb-err">PageNotFoundError</span>                         Traceback (most recent call last)
<span class="nb-dim">Cell In[404], line 3</span>
<span class="nb-dim">      1</span> <span class="nb-kw">from</span> praxis <span class="nb-kw">import</span> find_page
<span class="nb-arrow">----&gt; 3</span> page = find_page(<span class="nb-str">"the page you were looking for"</span>)

<span class="nb-err">PageNotFoundError</span>: this page may have moved when we reorganized the
website, or it belongs to a module that is not published yet.

<span class="nb-dim">Hint: try the search bar at the top, browse all topics, or head back
to the homepage.</span></code></pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="p404-actions">
    <a class="p404-btn p404-btn-primary" href="index.html">Back to the homepage</a>
    <a class="p404-btn p404-btn-ghost" href="pages/index/all.html">Browse all topics</a>
  </div>

  <p class="p404-help">Sure this page should exist? <a href="https://github.com/ubcecon/praxis-ubc/issues">Open an issue</a> or <a href="mailto:comet.project@ubc.ca">email the team</a>.</p>
</div>
```
